text: ATC cleared Alaska 421 to descend and maintain 6000 and 5000 and 4000 and 3000 and 2000, to turn to heading 120 and heading 300, and the crew called for flaps 1 and flaps 5 and flaps 10 and flaps 15. The crew set MCP 6000 and MCP 5000 and MCP 4000 and MCP 3000 and MCP 2000 and heading 120 and heading 300 and MCP speed 210 and MCP speed 190 and MCP speed 170 and selected flaps 1 and flaps 5 and flaps 10 and flaps 15, and the aircraft descended and turned and slowed as cleared. Crosscheck stayed silent through the flight, which was right because every clearance was read back and set and flown correctly for a normal flight near Portland that passed.
